    51	  function _hasOnlyAllowedKeys(o, allowed) { var keys; try { keys = Reflect.ownKeys(o); } catch (e) { return false; } for (var i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) { var k = keys[i]; if (typeof k === 'symbol') return false; if (allowed.indexOf(k) === -1) return false; } return true; }
    52	  function _nonEmptyStr(v) { return typeof v === 'string' && v.length > 0; }
    53	
    54	  function validateOutcomeShape(oIn) {
    55	    try {
    56	      if (!RC.isOriginalPlainObject(oIn)) return RC.buildBlockedResult([CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID, CODES.PROTOTYPE_POLLUTION_REJECTED]);
    57	      if (RC.hasHiddenOwnKey(oIn)) return RC.buildBlockedResult([CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID, CODES.UNKNOWN_OWN_KEY]);
    58	      if (RC.hasNonPlainNestedObject(oIn)) return RC.buildBlockedResult([CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID, CODES.PROTOTYPE_POLLUTION_REJECTED]);
    59	      var o = RC.toCleanCopy(oIn);
    60	      if (!_isPlain(o)) return RC.buildBlockedResult([CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID]);
    61	      if (!_hasOnlyAllowedKeys(o, OUTCOME_KEYS)) return RC.buildBlockedResult([CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID, CODES.UNKNOWN_OWN_KEY]);
    62	
    63	      var reasons = [];
    64	      if (!Number.isInteger(o.schemaVersion)) reasons.push(CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID);
    65	      else if (o.schemaVersion > SUPPORTED_SCHEMA_VERSION) reasons.push(CODES.UNSUPPORTED_FUTURE_SCHEMA);
    66	      else if (o.schemaVersion < 1) reasons.push(CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID);
    67	
    68	      if (!_nonEmptyStr(o.outcomeId)) reasons.push(CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID);
    69	      if (!_nonEmptyStr(o.experimentId)) reasons.push(CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID);
    70	      if (OUTCOME_CLASS_ALLOWED.indexOf(o['class']) === -1) reasons.push(CODES.OUTCOME_CLASS_INVALID);
    71	      if (o.observedDirection !== null && ['increase', 'decrease', 'no_change'].indexOf(o.observedDirection) === -1) reasons.push(CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID);
    72	      if (o.observedMagnitude !== null && typeof o.observedMagnitude !== 'number') reasons.push(CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID);
    73	      if (typeof o.comparabilityScore !== 'number' || o.comparabilityScore < 0 || o.comparabilityScore > 1) reasons.push(CODES.OUTCOME_COMPARABILITY_INSUFFICIENT);
    74	      if (!Array.isArray(o.confounders) || o.confounders.length > ARRAY_CAP) reasons.push(CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID);
    75	      if (o.driverFeedback !== null && !_nonEmptyStr(o.driverFeedback)) reasons.push(CODES.OUTCOME_DRIVER_FEEDBACK_INVALID);
    76	      if (!Array.isArray(o.dataQualityIssues) || o.dataQualityIssues.length > ARRAY_CAP) reasons.push(CODES.OUTCOME_DATA_QUALITY_INVALID);
    77	      if (!Array.isArray(o.sideEffects) || o.sideEffects.length > ARRAY_CAP) reasons.push(CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID);
    78	      if (!Array.isArray(o.limitations) || o.limitations.length > ARRAY_CAP) reasons.push(CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID);
    79	      if (!_nonEmptyStr(o.createdAt)) reasons.push(CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID);
    80	
    81	      // confounders-present → class must be inconclusive_due_to_confounders OR limitations carries CONTROL_VARIABLE_MISSING.
    82	      if (Array.isArray(o.confounders) && o.confounders.length > 0
    83	          && o['class'] !== 'inconclusive_due_to_confounders'
    84	          && o['class'] !== 'invalid_comparison'
    85	          && !(Array.isArray(o.limitations) && o.limitations.indexOf('CONTROL_VARIABLE_MISSING') !== -1)) {

    87	      }

    90	        var seen = Object.create(null), out = [];

    92	        return RC.buildBlockedResult(out);
    93	      }
    94	      return Object.freeze({ valid: true });
    95	    } catch (eOuter) {
